name: AWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's top singles belt, held by Mike Young going into Blood Is Thicker Than Water, where Cody Carson beat him for it in the ladder-billed main event of 25 September 2005; Carson is billed World champion in roleplays after.

name: AWA Continental Championship
epitaph: Held by Derek Cantina going into Blood Is Thicker Than Water, where teammate Michael Manson took it; by Adrenaline on 19 November 2005 Johnny Arnette is champion and The Rumbler beats him for it, and the record does not show how it passed between.

name: AWA Chaos Championship
epitaph: A hardcore belt called the Chaos Weight title in one card's script; The Rumbler is announced its champion after beating J Sane at Blood Is Thicker Than Water, and the record names no earlier holder.

name: AWA Fem-X Championship
epitaph: The women's belt, held by Brandi James at Blood Is Thicker Than Water and, from Adrenaline on 19 November 2005, by Skylar Black in the commentary's own words; Jamie Brant's roleplays of 2006 stage her winning it.

name: AWA X/Prime Unified Championship
epitaph: Made by Simon Sensation's win over Prime Time champion Angela Jameson at Blood Is Thicker Than Water, a finisher-only unification of the X and Prime Time belts.
